text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. Instead of just reading words, NLP allows machines to grasp meaning, context, and even emotion. For example, translation tools use NLP to convert text from one language to another while keeping the original intent. Sentiment analysis is another common use—it helps companies detect whether customer reviews are positive, negative, or neutral. Chatbots also rely on NLP to answer questions naturally, as if talking to a real person. From simple spell-checkers to complex virtual assistants, NLP is making communication between humans and machines smoother every day.
